definitions.explanation: A stand or platform from which a speaker delivers a speech or presentation. Can refer to either the raised platform or the stand that holds notes.

examples.japanese: {演台|えんだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
⟦{校長|こうちょう}→校長：01582_kouchou⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{演台|えんだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The principal gave a greeting from the podium.

examples.japanese: ⟦{緊張|きんちょう}→緊張：02494_kinchou⟧し⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧{演台|えんだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{話|はな}し→話す：00467_hanasu⟧{始|はじ}める⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{落|お}ち{着|つ}いて→落ち着く：04670_ochitsuku⟧きた。
examples.english: I nervously stepped up to the podium, but once I started speaking, I calmed down.

notes:
USAGE:
{演台|えんだい} is composed of {演|えん} (performance, speech) and {台|だい} (stand, platform). It refers to the physical lectern or podium where a speaker stands.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{壇上|だんじょう}→壇上：21719_danjou⟧ — on the platform/stage (refers to the elevated area, not the lectern)
- ⟦{講壇|こうだん}→講壇：24169_koudan⟧ — lecture platform, pulpit

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {演台|えんだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ (stand at the podium)
- {演台|えんだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧ (step up to the podium)
- {演台|えんだい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{離|はな}れる→離れる：02397_hanareru⟧ (leave the podium)
- {演台|えんだい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設置|せっち}する→設置する：26989_secchisuru⟧ (set up a podium)
